title: Al-Fatiha, Word by Word
summary: Every word of the opening surah and what it means.

sections.body:
Sūrat al-Fātiḥa (The Opening) is recited in every rakʿa of prayer. Understanding each word turns recitation you know by heart into meaning you can feel.

Read each āyah below, then study the words. The translations are close, word-level meanings to help you follow the Arabic. They are not a substitute for a full tafsīr.

items.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
All praise is for Allah, Lord of all the worlds,
the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful,
Master of the Day of Judgment.
You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path,

items.ar: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
items.en: the path of those You have blessed, not of those who earned anger, nor of those who went astray.

sections.body: Spot the patterns: ال means “the” (al-ḥamd, al-ʿālamīn), and نَ at the start of a verb means “we” (naʿbudu, nastaʿīnu).
